description: Aspen Mesh Packet Inspector (Pcapper) captures the HTTP/2 traffic flowing through the service mesh internally before it is converted from plaintext to mTLS. It generates the plaintext representation of that traffic and forwards it to a packet broker. This traffic is encrypted between Pcapper and the packet broker via outer TLS wrapper using keys and certs that identify both ends.
